metadata.description: Experimental Claude Code plugins for AI-assisted prototyping projects — personal toolkit, shared for testing.

plugins.name: project-setup
plugins.description: Scaffold a new prototyping project across a git repo and a Figma design library: repo structure, designer-friendly docs, app boilerplate (Next.js or Expo), brand-derived design tokens in a canonical DESIGN.md, and token emission to CSS, the theme and Figma. Generated projects are agent-agnostic — Claude Code, Cursor and Codex CLI first-class.
